name: Bhagavad Gita 9.22
text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
meaning: To those who worship me with single-minded devotion, ever steadfast, I bring what they lack and preserve what they have.
purpose: A verse about trust and care for those who are devoted; read as a spiritual teaching, not a guarantee of material outcomes.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
